visual_rules.palette: dark slate (#0f172a) + sky accent (#38bdf8), green success, amber warning, red danger
visual_rules.native_charts: 1 native editable column chart on slide 4 (recall by count/amount)

honesty_notes: All metrics in the deck are real recorded values from the locked test split (₹31,018,572.48 protected; ₹1,184,238 missed; 88.6% count / 96.3% amount recall).
No borrowed 99.9%/<1ms marketing claims from the generic Helix runtime; slide 5 shows measured RL Q-values and the panel documents measured recovery/gene-hit rates.
False-positive cost is disclosed on slide 6 and in speaker notes (defense-only tradeoff).
Gene table rows on slide 5 are real signature/strategy examples from the system's SQLite Gene Map.
limitations: Gene Map example rows on slide 5 are illustrative of the schema but from real runs where noted.
Slide 2 recovery comparison intentionally labels the 99.9% figure as a generic runtime claim, not our number.
